params.body:
The question left open in #263 is decided: the fifteen most recent posts are for a free account, not for every visitor. That is what the code already does (`Article::isLockedFor`: without an account every post shows its teaser), but the site still promised otherwise.

## What changes

- **Posts and Reports pages**: "The fifteen most recent are open to everyone." is gone. `Article::freeAccountLine()` says what a free account reads, following the same switch as `App\Access\Reader`:
  - `premium_requires_plan` on: "The fifteen most recent are yours in full with a free account."
  - off (the default, and the case until paid plans are switched on): "Every post is yours in full with a free account.", because then every account reads every post.
- **Featured post on Posts**: "Free to read" becomes "Free with an account".
- **The wall on a paid post, for a visitor without an account**: with `premium_requires_plan` on it said "Keep reading with a free account", and after signing up the reader met a second wall asking for Signal. It now says "This one comes with Signal" and that a free account opens the fifteen most recent posts; the button still leads to the free account. With the switch off nothing changes there, since a free account then does open it.
- The `OPEN_WINDOW` comment says who the window is for.

## Tests

New `FreeAccountLineTest`: Posts and Reports never say "open to everyone" and follow the switch; a visitor on a paid post is not told a free account opens it. `PremiumGateTest` and `SeoTagsTest` unchanged and green. The full suite passes apart from BuildStampTest, which fails in any worktree.
params.title: The open fifteen are for a free account
